text: ……ところで　そうこの　パスワード　って　なんだったっけ？

structure.jp: そうこの　パスワード　って

patterns.name: 〜っけ
patterns.explanation: っけ at the end shows you are trying to remember something you once knew: '...again?'. なんだったっけ = 'what was it again?'

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って here is a casual way to bring up the thing you want to talk about, like 'as for' or 'that ... thing'. パスワード　って = 'the password, (what was it)'.
